info.name: TBO - Hotel Certification FULL Pack (8 Cases) - Auto Chaining
info.description:
Full certification flow per case with auto chaining using tests/scripts.
Flow: Search -> PreBook -> Book -> GetBookingDetail -> GenerateVoucher.
No manual copy/paste of BookingCode/Token/Trace/BookingId.
IMPORTANT: Set Basic Auth at collection level in Postman (do not hardcode credentials).
Notes: Some booking engines require amounts/fields not available until runtime. Scripts try best-effort extraction.
